text.p: Rutherford-Moran Oil Corp said Tuesday production from its Tantawan Field in the Gulf of Thailand began last week.

The Tantawan Field is the first field in the gulf that produces crude oil and condensate as well as natural gas, the company noted. Rutherford-Moran Oil and Pogo Producing Co each have a 46.34 percent interest in the field with the rest held by a subsidiary of Sophonpanich Co Ltd.
The natural gas and crude oil production from the two wellhead platforms is being moved to the Tantawan Explorer Floating Production Storage and Offloading vessel.
The natural gas travels from the producing wells to the ship and after further processing is exported and sold to the Petroleum Authority of Thailand.
The Tantawan Explorer began accepting production on January 28 and started shipments of natural gas to the pipeline on Friday, January 31.
